config.source_manifest: data/commentary_schema.json (4-axis enum: Topic · Kazansky A/B/V/G · Lidova L1-L5 · P/K/D)
config.selection_rule: translator in {erman, grintser, kalyanov, leonov, syrkin, vassilkov}; the hand-curated gold-sample tier only (data/*_markup_50.json, 50 rows each) — excludes the larger *_full.json working files and the hand-written *_commentary_analysis.html essays, which sit outside this pipeline per CLAUDE.md
config.tier_filter: no rights-restricted tier in this repo's gold sample — all 300 rows are public per CITATION.cff / .zenodo.json (Apache-2.0)
config.digest_form: sha256 over the LF-canonical form (CRLF normalised) — reproducible from any compliant checkout

tool_versions.schema_validator: scripts/validate.py (schema + content gate) — rerun 2026-09-09: 6159 files checked, PASS
tool_versions.urn_validator: scripts/derive_urn.py --check (CTS-URN book<->number cross-check) — rerun 2026-09-09: 300/300 annotations resolved, PASS

licence.data_public_tier: Apache-2.0 — this repo has no separate LICENSE-DATA.md; CITATION.cff and .zenodo.json both declare the full corpus (including the gold sample) under Apache-2.0
